How to Play Mega Millions® 

NOTE: If the images do not appear, refresh your page or just scroll down to read the information.

Tickets cost $5 per play per drawing.

  1. Choose 5 numbers from 1 to 70 and a Mega Ball number from 1 to 24 or ask for a “Quick Pick” to let the machine pick random numbers for you.
  2. A multiplier (2X, 3X, 4X, 5X or 10X) will be randomly assigned to each play at the time of purchase at no additional cost.
  3. Win by matching your numbers to the numbers drawn in 1 of 9 ways.

      Built-in Multiplier Feature!

      The Multiplier feature is included in the price of each play. A multiplier will be randomly assigned for each play at the time of purchase.

      Multipliers are for non-jackpot prizes only.

        Play Up to 20 Drawings with Multi-Draw

        Whether you play your favorite numbers or choose Quick Picks, you can play up to twenty drawings in a row. Simply mark the appropriate box next to MULTI-DRAW on your play slip or ask the clerk for a Multi-Draw ticket ($5 per play per drawing).

        Cash vs. Annuity

        The advertised Jackpot Prize is paid as an annuity of 30 payments over 29 years or, at the election of the winner, in a single lump sum payment of the cash value of the annuity prize (prize subject to State and Federal taxes). If the winner chooses the annuity, the annual payments will be increased each year by a percentage set out in the MUSL Mega Millions (M2G2) Product Group Rules. Annuity payments are paid pursuant to MUSL Mega Millions (M2G2) Product Group Rules and New Mexico State Law.

        Please Note

        The advertised Jackpot is an annualized estimate of the actual Jackpot and is pari-mutuel.

        The Jackpot Prize shall be divided equally among winning Jackpot Prize plays. Each Jackpot Prize share that has a cash value of $1,000,000 or less is paid in a single payment. Any Jackpot Prize not won will be added to the next drawing’s Jackpot Prize.

        Some or all of the preset prizes may become pari-mutuel under certain circumstances as defined in the MUSL Mega Millions M2G2 Product Group Rules.
